'''Kesler''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] working for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he was captured by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and put into [[Shadow Town]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
